Part  IV(A) — GAZETTE  EXTRAORDINARY  OF  THE  DEMOCRATIC  SOCIALIST  REPUBLIC  OF  SRI  LANKA - 17.09.2025
The limits of the advanced accounts in Second Schedule of Revenue and Expenditure Estimates of the Year 2025 is
hereby amended as Second Schedule of this notification.
The permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2025 or up to the date that expires three months (03) from the
date of summoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the
Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs first.
